# Lior Gal Tax Advisory

> Lior Gal is an Israeli attorney (adv.) and CPA specializing in Israeli and international tax law: cross-border transactions, business restructuring (mergers, share exchanges, corporate splits), startup and high-tech taxation, tax rulings, and representation before the Israel Tax Authority. Ten years of experience inside the Israel Tax Authority (Capital Markets and Corporate Restructuring divisions) and at Meitar Law Offices. Based in Israel; works in Hebrew and English.

The site is bilingual: Hebrew pages at the site root, English pages under /en/. Each page links to its counterpart in the other language.

- [Home (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/index.html): overview of practice areas and background.
- [Home (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/index.html): English overview of practice areas and background.

- [About (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/about.html): professional background, timeline at the Israel Tax Authority and Meitar Law Offices, education and credentials (LL.B., CPA license, Israeli Bar).
- [About (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/about.html)

## Articles

- [הערכות שווי בשינויי מבנה (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/הערכות-שווי-בשינויי-מבנה.html): when a merger or spin-off requires an external expert valuation and when a management valuation is enough.
- [Valuations in Business Restructuring (English)](https://gal-tax.com/en/articles/valuations-in-business-restructuring.html)
- [יתרונות המיזוג (Hebrew)](https://gal-tax.com/articles/יתרונות-המיזוג.html): the main advantages of merging two companies after an acquisition - cost savings, loss offsetting, shareholder balances and retained earnings.
